units.source_text: 秀男抱着苗子的腰带一走上马路，彩虹就跳入了他的眼帘。

en.t: As soon as Hideo stepped out onto the road holding Naeko's obi, a rainbow leapt into view before his eyes.

units.source_text: 彩虹虽宽，色彩却很淡雅，还没有完全画出弓形来。

en.t: Though the rainbow was broad, its colors were pale and elegant, and it had not yet fully drawn its bow-shaped arc.

units.source_text: 秀男停住脚步，抬头仰望，只见彩虹的颜色渐渐淡去，仿佛要消失的样子。

en.t: Hideo stopped in his tracks and looked up, only to see the rainbow's colors gradually fading, as if it were about to disappear.
